name: agreement-scroll
title: Agreement scroll
description: Terms in a scrolling box with a read-progress line; the accept checkbox unlocks at the end, and keyboard users and short texts still work.
docs: Pass title, version and the text as children (h4, p, ol and ul are styled). The checkbox stays disabled until the reader reaches the end of the scrolling region, or at once when the text fits; once reached it stays unlocked, and a text that is already accepted can always be un-accepted. Control it with accepted and onAcceptedChange, or defaultAccepted. requireScroll={false} offers the text without the lock and hides the hint, the percentage and the jump button. The region is focusable and named by the title, so the arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Space and End scroll it; Jump to the end scrolls there (instantly under reduced motion) and hands the focus to the checkbox. A ResizeObserver checks again when the width changes. height sets the region's height (default 16rem), acceptLabel the words by the checkbox, name submits it with a form, and labels translates the fixed words.
